profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary: Software developer with a passion for technology and an eagerness to tackle new problems. I have experience with automation of business processes via NLU based chatbots, implemented through Slack.  I also have knowledge developing web based applications using SOAP/REST web services. Proficient in Java and C++. Experience with C#, C and JavaScript. Knowledge of SQL and relational database management systems.

company.name: Ethos Solutions - A Salesforce Silver Partner

positions.title: Case Administrator
positions.description:
Responsible for monitoring Adult Probationers' submittal for Interstate Compact Outgoing transfer of probation grant and assisting Adult Probation ISC Officer with ISC caseload (250 - 300 clients). 

• Conceptualized and implemented a pilot program which decreased average submittal time by at                                        least a month 

• Received Pride Award for collaborating with probation staff and demonstrating strong work ethic (Feb 2013)

• Recognized by the Department for conduct that exemplifies professionalism, dedication, willingness to help others, and commitment in working toward a safer community (Victim Service Award June 2015)
